messages:
sasha: Quick heads-up — new candidate model 'galene-38b' landed from research. Bench snapshot attached below. Need a fast prioritization for bring-up vs other slots.
chris: Can you paste the perf/quality numbers?
sasha: Perf summary (offline bench):
```
throughput: 120 tok/s (p50 latency 85ms)
mem: 58GB resident
perplexity: 12.3 (internal dev set)
winrate vs baseline: +3.5% on convo QA suite
```
leo: Nice throughput, but 58GB is high. Quant profiles? 8-bit only so far.
anita: Prioritization rubric reminder: customer impact, infra cost delta, regressions risk, roadmap alignment. Let's score 1-5 each.
maria: Roadmap note — Q2 latency push (webchat) would benefit from any model that reduces p50 -> prefers <=70ms.
chris: Quick initial scores proposal (Sasha/Chris draft):
- customer impact: 3
- infra cost delta: 2
- regression risk: 3
- roadmap alignment: 4
=> total 12/20.
sasha: I ran a quick eval bot: @eval-bot gives breakdown (high-level):
eval-bot: EVAL_SUMMARY galene-38b vs prod-orpheus: +3.4% helpfulness, -0.9% factual accuracy on long answers, hallucination rate unchanged.
leo: Given mem pressure, I recommend trying these in order: 1) 4-bit quant smoke (llm-qfast), 2) KVcache tuning (shard policy), 3) short-context distillation if needed.
anita: If 4-bit reduces mem below 40GB with <1% quality drop, we can slot it into a canary on Dedicated.
infra-bot: current cluster capacity for canaries this week: 2x A100-80 pools free starting Tue. Risk of bumping other bringups: medium.
maria: If we want priority this sprint, request: canary resources + eval harness run + SLO target (p50 <= 80ms) by EOD Wed.
sasha: Proposed action items:
- @leo: run 4-bit quant smoke + regtest (owner) — deliver Tue noon
- @chris: add scoring to model shelf doc, finalize 12->decision threshold (owner) — Wed EOD
- @anita: confirm roadmap fit and customer ask (owner) — Tue EOD
- @maria: reserve canary slot with infra (owner) — today
- @eval-bot: run long-answer factuality check (bot) — queued
chris: Agreed. If 4-bit fails, deprioritize unless fidelity holds.
sasha: Cool. I'll follow up with a short checklist for bring-up if 4-bit passes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
